lesson.concept: How an outbreak grows or shrinks
lesson.big_idea: Every outbreak is a chain: each sick person infects some others. If each infects more than one, cases grow; if fewer than one, the outbreak dies out. Vaccines and contact tracing work by pushing that number below one.

steps.title: Count onward infections
steps.text: Take one sick person and count how many people they infect. The average over many cases is R, the reproduction number. Ebola spreads through close contact with a sick person's body fluids.

steps.title: Above one grows, below one fades
steps.text: If R is 2, then 100 cases become 200, then 400. If R is 0.5, then 100 cases become 50, then 25, and the outbreak ends.

steps.title: Ring vaccination cuts R
steps.text: Health workers find each case, list everyone they touched, and vaccinate that ring of people. Protected contacts can't pass the virus on, so each chain gets shorter and R drops.

steps.title: It needs a matching vaccine
steps.text: A vaccine trains antibodies to one surface protein. Ervebo targets the Zaire strain, and Bundibugyo's protein differs, so it doesn't protect well. Bundibugyo-specific vaccines are only now headed for trials.

steps.title: It needs you to find cases
steps.text: You can only ring-vaccinate around a case you know about. In August officials said only about a third of cases were confirmed. Every missed case keeps spreading at the full rate.

example.setup: Imagine a district with 90 Ebola cases this month. Assume each case, left alone, infects 2 people. Assume a matched vaccine given to contacts cuts that to 0.5 people per case.

lines.label: No vaccine
lines.note: R is 2, so the outbreak doubles.

lines.label: Every case found
lines.note: Vaccinating every ring pushes R below one, so it shrinks.

lines.label: Only a third found
lines.note: Like the share officials said was confirmed in August.

lines.label: Found cases spread
lines.note: Their contacts were vaccinated.

lines.label: Missed cases spread
lines.note: Nobody knew to protect their contacts.

lines.label: Total next month
lines.note: Up from 90: still growing, even with a good vaccine.

example.result: Even a good vaccine can't stop an outbreak if two in three cases are missed: cases grow from 90 to 135. Ring vaccination needs both things at once: a matched vaccine and found cases.

apply.text: Congo's outbreak has passed 11,000 cases, and Africa CDC calls it DRC's fastest-growing outbreak. The lesson says ring vaccination needs two things. On the first, Ervebo, used in earlier DRC outbreaks, doesn't protect well against Bundibugyo. On the second, in August officials said only about a third of cases were confirmed. The trials WHO groups backed on 2 November will test vaccines built for Bundibugyo.

practice.q: Same district of 90 cases, same R values, but workers now find two-thirds of cases. How many cases next month?
practice.answer: Two-thirds of 90 = 60 found, so 30 are missed. Found: 60 × 0.5 = 30. Missed: 30 × 2 = 60. Total: 30 + 60 = 90. Cases hold steady, so finding still more cases is what tips the outbreak into shrinking.

scenes.speak: यह ज़्यादा जानलेवा भी है। Africa CDC के मुताबिक लगभग आधे patients की मौत हो जाती है। Uganda के पहले outbreak में लगभग 4 में से 1 की मौत हुई थी। May से 5300 से ज़्यादा लोगों की मौत हो चुकी है।

scenes.say: Ab sabse zaroori idea. Har outbreak ek chain hai. Har beemar insaan doosron ko infect karta hai. Ebola body fluids ke kareebi sampark se phailta hai. Ek insaan average kitne logon ko infect karta hai, use R kehte hain. R 1 se upar hai, toh cases badhte hain. 1 se neeche hai, toh outbreak dheere dheere khatam hone lagta hai.
scenes.speak: अब सबसे ज़रूरी idea। हर outbreak एक chain है। हर बीमार इंसान दूसरों को infect करता है। Ebola body fluids के करीबी संपर्क से फैलता है। एक इंसान average कितने लोगों को infect करता है, उसे R कहते हैं। R 1 से ऊपर है, तो cases बढ़ते हैं। 1 से नीचे है, तो outbreak धीरे धीरे खत्म होने लगता है।

scenes.say: Toh R ko 1 se neeche kaise laayein? Ring vaccination se. Health workers har case dhoondhte hain, uske sampark mein aaye har insaan ki list banaate hain, aur logon ke us ring ko vaccine lagaate hain. Protected contacts virus aage nahi badha sakte. Lekin iske liye 2 cheezein chahiye: matching vaccine, aur cases ka milna.
scenes.show: Needs a match, and found cases
scenes.speak: तो R को 1 से नीचे कैसे लाएं? Ring vaccination से। Health workers हर case ढूंढते हैं, उसके संपर्क में आए हर इंसान की list बनाते हैं, और लोगों के उस ring को vaccine लगाते हैं। Protected contacts virus आगे नहीं बढ़ा सकते। लेकिन इसके लिए 2 चीज़ें चाहिए: matching vaccine, और cases का मिलना।

scenes.say: Chaliye karke dekhte hain. Maan lijiye ek district mein 90 cases hain. Har case 2 logon ko infect karta hai. Yaani agle mahine 180. Ab farz kijiye matching vaccine ise ghataakar aadha insaan per case kar deti hai. Agar har case mil jaaye, toh 90 guna aadha, 45. Outbreak chhota ho jaata hai.
scenes.speak: चलिए करके देखते हैं। मान लीजिए एक district में 90 cases हैं। हर case 2 लोगों को infect करता है। यानी अगले महीने 180। अब फ़र्ज़ कीजिए matching vaccine इसे घटाकर आधा इंसान per case कर देती है। अगर हर case मिल जाए, तो 90 गुना आधा, 45। Outbreak छोटा हो जाता है।

scenes.say: Lekin ab sochiye sirf ek tihaai cases milte hain, jaisa officials ne August mein Congo ke liye bataya tha. 30 mile: 30 guna aadha, 15. 60 chhoot gaye: 60 guna 2, 120. Total 135, jo 90 se zyada hai. Agar zyaadatar cases chhupe hain, toh achhi vaccine bhi jeet nahi sakti.
scenes.speak: लेकिन अब सोचिए सिर्फ एक तिहाई cases मिलते हैं, जैसा officials ने August में Congo के लिए बताया था। 30 मिले: 30 गुना आधा, 15। 60 छूट गए: 60 गुना 2, 120। Total 135, जो 90 से ज़्यादा है। अगर ज़्यादातर cases छुपे हैं, तो अच्छी vaccine भी जीत नहीं सकती।

scenes.say: Times of India ne poocha ki kya India ko chinta karni chahiye. Filhaal seedha asar kam hai. Hamare paas jo reports hain, unme India mein koi case nahi bataya gaya. Africa ke bahar sirf UK aur France ka zikr hai. India ka link lab mein hai: Serum Institute of India ne ek nayi vaccine co-develop ki hai.
scenes.speak: Times of India ने पूछा कि क्या India को चिंता करनी चाहिए। फिलहाल सीधा असर कम है। हमारे पास जो reports हैं, उनमें India में कोई case नहीं बताया गया। Africa के बाहर सिर्फ UK और France का ज़िक्र है। India का link lab में है: Serum Institute of India ने एक नई vaccine co-develop की है।

scenes.say: Ek aam galatfehmi yeh hai ki Ebola vaccines toh pehle se hain, isliye yeh aasaan hona chahiye. Licensed vaccine Ervebo ek alag strain ko target karti hai. Bundibugyo ki vaccines ab jaakar trials mein ja rahi hain. Hamara lesson dikhata hai ki yeh kyun maayne rakhta hai: matched vaccine ke bina, aur cases chhootne par, chain badhti reh sakti hai.
scenes.speak: एक आम गलतफ़हमी यह है कि Ebola vaccines तो पहले से हैं, इसलिए यह आसान होना चाहिए। Licensed vaccine Ervebo एक अलग strain को target करती है। Bundibugyo की vaccines अब जाकर trials में जा रही हैं। हमारा lesson दिखाता है कि यह क्यों मायने रखता है: matched vaccine के बिना, और cases छूटने पर, chain बढ़ती रह सकती है।

scenes.say: Aage kya? Congo ki health ministry, WHO aur Africa CDC ke naye case counts par nazar rakhiye, jo ab bhi alag alag hain. Vaccine trials ke nateeje 2027 ki shuruaat mein aane ki ummeed hai. Kenya mein aakhri case 20 October ko aaya tha, dekhiye wahan shaanti bani rehti hai ya nahi. Abhi pata nahi: maut ka sahi aankda, kya badhat dheemi ho rahi hai, aur containment fail kyun ho raha hai.
scenes.image: Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention
scenes.speak: आगे क्या? Congo की health ministry, WHO और Africa CDC के नए case counts पर नज़र रखिए, जो अब भी अलग अलग हैं। Vaccine trials के नतीजे 2027 की शुरुआत में आने की उम्मीद है। Kenya में आखिरी case 20 October को आया था, देखिए वहां शांति बनी रहती है या नहीं। अभी पता नहीं: मौत का सही आंकड़ा, क्या बढ़त धीमी हो रही है, और containment fail क्यों हो रहा है।

scenes.say: 3 baatein yaad rakhiye. Outbreak tabhi chhota hota hai jab har case 1 se kam doosre insaan ko infect kare. Congo ka outbreak 11 November tak 11000 cases paar kar gaya, aur Bundibugyo ki koi proven vaccine ab bhi nahi hai. Aur 2027 ki shuruaat mein Bundibugyo vaccine trials ke nateejon par nazar rakhiye.
scenes.show: R below 1, matched vaccine, find cases
scenes.speak: 3 बातें याद रखिए। Outbreak तभी छोटा होता है जब हर case 1 से कम दूसरे इंसान को infect करे। Congo का outbreak 11 November तक 11000 cases पार कर गया, और Bundibugyo की कोई proven vaccine अब भी नहीं है। और 2027 की शुरुआत में Bundibugyo vaccine trials के नतीजों पर नज़र रखिए।

quiz.q: Why could October 2026 inflation read about 6% even if prices rose only moderately over the year?
options: Because the milk hikes of 12 November count in October's figure
Because October 2025 inflation was a record-low 0.25%, so the base is low
Because the RBI raised the repo rate to 5.5% in October
quiz.why: Inflation compares with the same month a year earlier. A very low October 2025 base makes the October 2026 comparison look bigger.

quiz.q: Why did oil rise about 1% on 11 November, even though OPEC+ was pumping close to pre-war levels?
options: Iran's refusal to send out its uranium made a quick peace deal look less likely, adding fear back
OPEC+ suddenly cut its October output
Indian oil companies raised pump prices
quiz.why: Supply was recovering, so barrels were not the cause. The rise came from renewed fear that the war would drag on.

quiz.q: Why could Russia and Ukraine agree a prisoner exchange but not a deal on territory?
options: A swap is small and checkable step by step; land is all-or-nothing and needs trust they lack
Prisoner swaps need no mediator, while territory talks need the US
Territory was simply left off the agenda in Abu Dhabi
quiz.why: Swaps can be done in batches and verified, limiting risk. Handing over land cannot be undone, and the US cited a lack of trust.
